secondary_gate.name: SECONDARY_CONTROLLED_DIVERGENCE_GATE
pass_iff: D_h,PROCEDURAL > 0 for each of the five frozen skeletons
secondary_gate.finite_set_directional_pattern: all-positive is 1 of the 32 possible sign patterns over five frozen effects
secondary_gate.statistical_wording_boundary: This is a prospective finite-suite claim-adjudication rule. Do not describe it as an exact p=1/32 test unless a separate null sign-exchangeability/symmetry assumption and inferential test are prospectively frozen.

claim_authority_if_pass.allowed: On the frozen controlled suite, the alternative learner projection outperformed the served-winner learner projection across all five preregistered procedural-transformation skeletons while the realized search pools and served behavior were held fixed.

if_secondary_gate_fails.allowed_next_claim_expansion: separately preregistered out-of-family ordinary-observable projection transport test, only if primary V3 interaction passed

math_note: Combinatorially, for five procedural skeleton effects and a mean/sum sign-flip statistic, the observed assignment can be the unique maximum among 32 sign assignments only when all five observed effects are positive; any negative effect can be sign-flipped to yield a larger statistic. Treating the resulting 1/32 tail fraction as an exact inferential p-value would additionally require an appropriate prospectively justified null sign-exchangeability/symmetry assumption.
